Privacy Policy

Last updated: 2026-10-13

Dictation Notes (听写笔记) provides transcription and AI help on Mac and iPhone. We do not operate an application content backend. Apple and your selected providers may process data; support emails are handled as described below.

What stays on your deviceApple speech recognitionMac microphone and system audioProviders you configureControls you already have

Who publishes the app

The app is published on the App Store by Shanghai Qishan Cultural Communication Co., Ltd. Copyright is marked © 2026 Zhichao Wei. Privacy questions: 281916057@qq.com.

Data we do not collect

There is no developer server receiving accounts, analytics events, advertising IDs, or crash dossiers. The app does not embed a tracking SDK and does not track across apps.

What stays on your device

API keys use the system Keychain on iPhone and Mac. Recordings, transcripts, session history and settings are stored on the device; there is no developer content server or automatic history synchronization. Exports go to the destination you choose. Clear history and keys in the app before uninstalling if you want to remove them.

Apple speech recognition

On Mac, free dictation prefers recognition on the device. iPhone may use on-device recognition or Apple speech services. If a Mac offline model is unavailable or fails, audio may also be sent to Apple speech services. Apple processes received audio under its privacy policy. The app explains possible Apple processing before listening and requests system speech recognition permission. Microphone and optional Mac system audio capture also require system permission.

Providers you configure

After your permission, cloud transcription sends audio to your chosen speech provider. AI replies, translation and summaries send transcripts, questions, conversation history and any background you enter to your chosen AI provider. On Mac, permission identifies the provider and endpoint; changing the recipient requires new permission. Each provider determines its own processing, retention and international transfers. A model running on this Mac receives text locally.

Cloud providers may retain audio and other user content after a request, together with API account identifiers, request times and counts, token usage, error/trace logs and network information such as IP addresses. These may be linked to your provider account. They support authentication, transcription, AI features, security and service operations. Some providers also analyze usage or use submitted content to improve or train models under their own terms and account settings. The app does not send advertising identifiers or use these requests for advertising tracking.

Retention, model training and international processing depend on the provider, endpoint, plan and account settings. We do not promise universal zero retention or no training. Check the linked current provider policies before sending sensitive content. Local deletion or revoking permission stops future sending but does not erase data already received by a provider; request deletion from that provider.

Alibaba Cloud Model Studio · OpenAI API · Gemini API · ElevenLabs

Mac microphone and system audio

Mac can capture a microphone, system audio or mixed input. System capture requires the macOS screen and system audio recording permission. ScreenCaptureKit supplies audio to the chosen recognition path and, when enabled, a local M4A or WAV recording. The app does not save screen video. Audio may include other participants or sounds from other apps.

Device history, exports and backups

The app does not automatically synchronize Mac and iPhone history or recordings. Purchase restoration restores the unlock only. Exporting, sharing or an operating-system backup may create copies at your chosen destination; that destination or backup service has its own privacy policy. Deleting the original does not delete these copies.

Recording and consent

Recordings and transcripts may contain sensitive conversation. Use recording, transcription, or summaries only where legal and with any required consent. The app repeats this notice before the first listening session.

Purchases

The lifetime unlock is processed by Apple through the App Store. We do not receive or store payment card information. Apple may process purchase receipts under its own privacy policy. This is a non-consumable one-time purchase, not an auto-renewing subscription.

App Store privacy label

The App Store label includes optional cloud-provider collection of audio, other user content, user IDs, usage, diagnostic and network data. Data may be linked to your provider account. The developer does not receive audio, transcripts, AI prompts or payment card details.

This website

This static site is hosted on GitHub Pages. We use no analytics, advertising, tracking SDKs or language-preference storage. Fonts and screenshots are served with the site. GitHub may process IP addresses and ordinary access logs under its privacy policy. Visiting App Store or provider links is subject to the destination's policy.

GitHub · Apple · Apple Speech

Controls you already have

You can delete sessions, recordings and keys in the app. On Mac, Settings also lets you revoke data sharing permission and stop current requests. Deleting the Mac app alone may leave local data; clear history and keys in the app before uninstalling. Copies you exported or shared must be deleted at their destination.

Children

The app is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal data from children.

Changes

If this policy changes in a material way, we will update the date and publish the revision here. Continued use means you have seen the updated notice.

Support requests

If you email support, we receive your email address, message and any diagnostics or attachments you choose to send. We use them to answer and investigate your request. You can contact 281916057@qq.com to request deletion, subject to applicable retention requirements. Do not include API keys, private recordings or sensitive transcripts.

Contact

For privacy questions write to 281916057@qq.com and include device, OS version, and app version. Do not paste API keys or raw recordings in email.
